steps.title: Seed cells
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁶ U2OS (or other) cells per 15 cm dish so that they reach confluence after 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare electroporation reagents
steps.instruction: Warm cell culture medium, trypsin/EDTA, and HBSS to 37 °C; set up the Neon electroporation holder and pipette 3 mL of E2 electrolytic buffer into the electroporation tube; label three 1.5 mL tubes with 1 mL pre‑warmed medium (for recovery), three 1.5 mL tubes with 3–5 µg plasmid DNA each, and three 1.5 mL tubes with 1 mL PBS (for tip rinsing).

steps.title: Detach and wash cells
steps.instruction: Remove medium from the 15 cm plate, wash cells with 10 mL PBS, add 1.5 µL warm trypsin, incubate 3–5 min at 37 °C, then add 15 mL warm medium, transfer cells to a 50 mL Falcon tube, centrifuge 200 × g for 3 min at room temperature, wash twice with 10 mL PBS (centrifuge each wash 200 × g for 3 min), resuspend the final pellet in 1 mL PBS, transfer to a 1.5 mL tube, centrifuge 300 × g for 1 min (MiniSpin), discard supernatant, resuspend in 1 mL warm HBSS, centrifuge again 300 × g for 1 min, and finally resuspend the pellet in 330 µL warm HBSS.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: For each condition perform three electroporation rounds using 100 µL of the cell suspension per round (add excess to avoid bubbles). Mix the 330 µL cell suspension with the appropriate plasmid DNA tube, transfer to the Neon electroporation tube, set program to 1 150 V, 30 ms, 2 pulses, and electroporate. Immediately transfer electroporated cells to a 1.5 mL tube containing 1 mL warm medium, gently invert, and keep at 37 °C. Repeat the electroporation two more times for the same condition, rinsing the pipette tip in PBS between conditions. After the three rounds, centrifuge the cells 300 × g for 1 min, resuspend in 1 mL warm medium, plate in a 10 cm dish with a final volume of 10 mL medium, and incubate 24 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare lysis and wash solutions
steps.instruction: Make the following on ice (RNase‑free): 35 mL PBS + CHX to 0.1 mg/mL, 2.5 mL lysis buffer (as per recipe), 1.2 mL TBS 1×, 3 mL wash buffer, 600 µL puromycin elution buffer, and 600 µL 3× Flag peptide elution buffer.

steps.title: Lyse cells and collect input
steps.instruction: Add CHX to the electroporated 10 cm plates to a final 0.1 mg/mL, incubate 15 min at 37 °C, place plates on ice, quickly wash once with 10 mL ice‑cold PBS + CHX (0.1 mg/mL), scrape cells into 1 mL ice‑cold PBS + CHX, transfer to 1.5 mL tubes, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, resuspend pellets in 200 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer, incubate 15 min on ice, centrifuge 12 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, transfer 180 µL supernatant (Input) to a new tube, set aside 10 µL for RNA isolation, keep the rest on ice.

steps.title: Prepare anti‑Flag beads
steps.instruction: Mix anti‑Flag M2 magnetic beads to a homogeneous suspension, transfer 40 µL bead slurry per condition to a 1.5 mL tube, discard storage solution, wash beads twice with 600 µL ice‑cold TBS 1× (invert 4–5× each wash). Add 750 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer, split equally into three 1.5 mL tubes, add 170 µL of the corresponding Input sample to each tube, and incubate overnight at 4 °C with gentle rotation (10–30 rpm).

steps.title: Wash beads post‑IP
steps.instruction: Discard flow‑through, wash beads twice with 500 µL ice‑cold wash buffer (invert 4–5× each wash).

steps.title: Elute nascent chains
steps.instruction: Choose elution method: • Puromycin: add 200 µL puromycin elution buffer to each tube, rotate 30 min at 4 °C (10–30 rpm), collect eluate on ice. • 3× Flag peptide: add 100 µL 3× Flag peptide elution buffer, rotate 30 min at 4 °C (10–30 rpm), collect eluate, repeat once more, pool the two 100 µL eluates (total 200 µL) and keep on ice. Proceed immediately to RNA isolation.

steps.title: Purify RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from Input and Elution samples using the Monarch RNA Cleanup kit (including on‑column DNA digestion) according to the manufacturer’s protocol; elute each sample in 30 µL ice‑cold nuclease‑free H₂O, measure concentration and purity with a NanoDrop, and optionally add EDTA to a final 0.1–1 mM (ensure compatibility with downstream RT‑qPCR). Store purified RNA at –80 °C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Set up one‑step RT‑qPCR
steps.instruction: Thaw Luna Universal One‑Step RT‑qPCR kit, primers, and RNA samples on ice. Prepare a master mix for 20 reactions (three conditions + 1 no‑template control + 1 extra for pipetting error) as per kit instructions; vortex and spin briefly. Dispense master mix into 19 wells of a 96‑well plate, add each RNA sample to three wells, add nuclease‑free water to the no‑template control well equal to the RNA volume. Avoid bubbles while pipetting, briefly spin the plate to collect drops and remove bubbles, seal with an optical adhesive film, cover with foil, load onto the RT‑qPCR machine, and run the program recommended by the kit.
